notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26303899/4dbc5b389b2595cee1aed8776e4d03911eebd88c.jpg

Hey everyone,

As we’re headed toward the end of the season it’s a great time for a community update, starting with some upcoming changes to Deceit. Over the next few releases we’re going to be introducing a fresh perk tree, fixing up a few more hitches, and gradually phasing in some brand-new mechanics – topping it off with an additional item based on the Terror’s weakness to light. 

It’s worth mentioning as a sort of disclaimer **this is a preview and only partially indicative of final gameplay**, some of this stuff may change though we’re pretty confident in how it’s working out in internal play testing.

Blackout changes
A prevailing thought in community feedback has been that the Terror doesn’t quite feel like the superhuman killing machine it was engineered to be. Our bogeyman may be at home in the dark but with defensive strategy from the opposing side it can be difficult to achieve much against the coordination and positioning innocent players often utilise. In the current version of Deceit, the blackout phase can be shortened by innocents collecting fuses, prematurely restarting the lights to force the Terrors back into their human form and ensure their own safety, but if they choose not to the lights just come back on anyway and their escape continues mostly unhindered. 

Our next patch aims to shake this up a bit, introducing part one of our light and darkness gameplay changes: Unending Darkness. During the blackout, innocents can collect fuses and the infected can use their strength to transform, executing players as they did before but with one major change; if the test subjects choose not to complete the sinister Game Master’s objective, the Terror’s will gain strength from their time in the darkness, powering up into an early enrage period. This enrage period only ends if the fuses are placed inside the fuse box, bringing the lights back on and continuing the game as normal.

The goals for this change are to not only sharpen up the game thematically but to increase the value of each item as innocents will find their use crucial for fighting towards their objective and surviving in the darkness

Light changes
Alongside changes to the darkness in Deceit we’re going to be revamping the way that terrors interact with light; we’re removing the physical damage component caused by items such as the camera and trap and adding an entirely new stat: Light damage. Light damage will only affect terrors in terror form and works separately from their normal health, the more light damage inflicted on a terror the slower the terror will move, allowing innocents to make their escape. If a terror takes enough light damage they’ll be temporarily stunned and immune to receiving any further light damage until they’ve fully recovered so don’t stick around for long!

In line with the light changes we’re also tweaking the camera to have a clearer targeting reticule allowing users to see if the terror is in range and require a short charge up before use to reign in the so-called paparazzi plays.

Terror Luminescence
Rounding out our list of new mechanics, light damage also has a secondary effect called Terror Luminescence, when a terror takes light damage they’ll also light up making it easier for innocent players to coordinate in an attempt to bring them down. Once they’re back in the dark (or if they’re shot until they respawn) the glow gradually fades until they’re back to their normal stealthy look.

New Item: Flashlight
Marking the introduction of a horror movie classic, the flashlight will be a new source of light damage, projecting a cone of light which can be aimed at an incoming terror to help keep them at bay. In our current test build, as with the camera, it’s damage is based on range and increases the closer the terror is to the light source making for some hair raising escapes so long as it doesn’t run out of batteries…

Stay up to date!
Whether you’re itching to read the follow up post full of numbers and bullet points, can’t wait to see the latest videos from our staff talking about upcoming changes or want to share your favourite Deceit moments with us and the rest of our fans – be sure to stay up to date by following us on Twitter, Facebook and Twitch TV for all of the latest news. 

Sam Hills
Community Manager

notes.title: v3.3.0 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26303899/856da1a8300a05141409f7513b08c20aa8117629.jpg

Features

Daily hiscore rewards have been added
Top 10 will receive 3 loot booth tokens and 250 credits. Top 100 receives 1 loot booth token and 100 credits to spend in the store
Added hit markers for traps
Re-designed multiple in-game UI elements including waypoints and item icons
Tweaks have been made to the lighting in multiple maps
When entering a game the main menu UI now says "Game Found" instead of putting you into a game straight away



Perk Changes

The 'Eye Spy' perk has been re-worked to now allowing you to see name tags at a close distance in the dark, instead of allowing you to see name tags from further away
The 'Interrogate' perk was changed to "If you're involved in a vote that passed there is a chance that you will be told if they were Infected. Only one person can be informed per passing vote." This mean there is no longer a 100% chance of it working if no one else in the game owns the perk



Bug Fixes

Fixed lethal injection stats being incorrectly tracked
Emblems that are no longer accessible aren't shown any more
Terrors now regenerate health when out of combat
Terrors can now kill multiple people during the enrage period as expected
Terrors are no longer transformed back to human form after killing during the enrage period
Terrors can now transform correctly after using the lethal injection
Players no longer escape if they respawn after being downed on an exit that opens
The Interrogate perk no longer has a 100% chance of working if no one else in the game owns the perk
The prices of unlocks have been fixed to represent their true value
Certain trees have had their colliders change to stop players from getting to unintended parts of the map
Limited the values to which the brightness slider can be set to
Added more checks to stop people from being unintentionally be put into games
Fixed MVP/LVP Steam achievements
Fixed the left arrow on the character select screen not showing

notes.title: v3.2.0 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26303899/b2a27abac36a1108ebe4e2c1eebea4025ebcaa46.jpg

Features

Party members' models now join you on the main menu.
You can now view the last character your friend played as when hovering over their name in the friends list.
Introduced new perk system.


New Perk System
The legacy trait system has now been replaced with something we've called the Perk Tree! A selection of character buffs that will change each month, available from the main menu. As you earn XP in-game you will collect points that you can spend in the tree, creating a chain of perks that suits your playstyle. The system allows us to keep the game fresh by offering a variety of strategies month-on-month that players can use to aid in their trust and deception tactics. Reach the end of the tree before the end of the season to unlock a unique emblem for that tree. Go even further by unlocking all the perks in the tree to also receive an improved version of the emblem.

Miscellaneous

The XP bar has been removed from the character select screen.
Updated the lighting in the Asylum map.
Tweaked our anti-cheat detection to stop falsely eliminating players at the beginning of the round.
Loading screen messages have been re-added.


Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue where the shotgun would disappear and not allow players to change weapons.
Killing a player in terror form while falling now causes the blood bar to reset correctly.
Added potential fixes for players being left in a strange state after transforming.
Fixed a UI bug on the end of round screen where the experience bar would overflow.
NiNa now uses the correct trouser model on certain outfits to stop clipping issues with her belt.
Players' prestige now shows correctly on the loading screen.
The reward type prefix on the loot booth screen has been fixed for Terror cosmetics.
Added blocking under Arctic stairs to prevent players respawning under them.
Removed a box in Arctic to prevent players jumping on shelves.
It is no longer possible to re-select the item you're currently equipping.
Fixed multiple miscellaneous crashes that have been reported.
Added more objects to be pre-cached whilst loading.
Fixed an animation cancel when going through vents.
Level and Prestige are now correctly displayed on the loading screen.
Fixed aim poses for several items.

notes.title: v3.00.0 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26303899/cf1ce4bd422cd2011621791aae6ccc2ed40789e8.jpg

Features
Our 2 new characters, Hans and NiNa, have been added into the game!
Werewolf Terror Skin! Has been added.
Hungarian and Italian languages have been added.
Progression Update
Character levels have been consolidated into one level. All previous XP has been added together to give you your current amount.
The amount of XP to level up starts at 1.5k and increases up to a flat amount of 10K.
10 prestiges have been added to the game. Reaching lvl 100 will automatically prestige you. You lose nothing by prestiging.
We've introduced a Casual and a Ranked queue. Casual queue allows playing with groups of any size but Ranked queue limits it to 2. You unlock Ranked by reaching level 10.
Traits are now shared across all characters. You can now only select a normal T1, T2 and T3 trait along with a terror T1 and T2 trait.
Trait challenges are now unlocked via Loot Booth tokens. If you have previously completed a challenge you will still have the trait. If you unlock a challenge you had previously progressed you will keep that progress.


Main Menu Update
The background scene has been updated.
An asset revamp! An initial pass has been made so far but more will be coming over the following month.
The tutorial video link has been updated to the latest version.
The build number is now shown in the bottom right, clicking on it will bring up the latest patch notes.
Newly unlocked items are now marked in your cosmetics tab under Profile.
The Profile button will appear golden if you have unseen cosmetics.
The Loot Booth button will appear golden if you have tokens to spend.
You no longer receive a notification when you get an item from the Loot Booth.


Chat & Friends Systems
You can now add friends in Deceit (Steam friends will be automatically imported).
See if your friends are in game, offline or ready to play!
When friends with someone you can privately message them and view their profile.
Party chat was added to the main menu to allow you to communicate while searching for games.


Player profiles
Statistics - See how many times you've stolen an objective or how often your friend gets voted out!
Daily XP Highscores - Earn Loot Booth tokens and GM Credits by reaching the top 10/100 for XP gained in a day!
Seasonal Elo Highscores - Earn Bronze cosmetics for reaching the Elo system and Gold/Silver for hitting the top 10/100!
Reputation Highscores - Compare your reputation with others. You can tip player profiles for 20 GM Credits in the Main Menu or for free at the end of a game.
Traits - View your progression on unlocked traits.
Notes - Examine notes found around the game.
Cosmetics - Customise your characters.
Match History - View your past 20 games played.
Loot booth rewards are now shown in 3D to give you a better idea of the items collected.
If you have traits to unlock you will get both a cosmetic and a trait challenge from cups in the loot booth. Selecting rarer cups will earn you higher tier challenges.


Balancing
Terrors now move faster but have less health, when they are downed they re-spawn. When they re-spawn they lose one blood bar segment. A full blood bar is need to transform into terror form but only one is required to perform an execution. So even if you are downed with full blood you still have a chance to execute.
Infected players now have terror sense during the day period, letting them have a better idea of where innocent players are and making it easier to collect blood.


Bug Fixes
Fixed a number of environment bugs across all three maps.
Knife skins have been fixed.
Fixed players not receiving emblems for reaching Diamond.
Fixed a bug in the loot booth where the cup selected didn't have the correct reward in it.


Miscellaneous 
The vents in the Arctic map have been updated to the correct model.
Optimisation across all 3 maps, Arctic, Forest and Asylum
Added a skip button to the loot boot. Pressing it will give you a random reward.

notes.title: July 5th - Update Preview
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26303899/4ec0c0c8623e21840bb73996cc688b41bfd23c4a.jpg

On July 5th, we’re releasing our biggest Deceit update yet, encompassing a whole new host of features which we’re further detailing today!

Queue System Changes
Region Lock
Region locks will allow players to select strict limits on regions to play in and select language(s) that they feel comfortable communicating in, helping players to better understand each other in an average game of Deceit.
Ranked and Casual queues
Casual play will allow players to level up, learn the ropes and play with parties of any size. Ranked will require the player to have reached level 10, ensuring they have a reasonable understanding of the game, and will be restricted to parties of two.

UI Overhaul
Player profiles
Like many popular multiplayer games, players will have their own profile allowing them to see their stats and performance in the game.
Friends list
In preparation for allowing players to purchase the game through other platforms instead of Steam, the new user interface will feature a brand-new friends list. Players can add each other as friends by sharing a short code which is unique to them.
Chat system
Players will be able to chat with their friends and party members outside of a match.
Reputation system
Players will be able to commend other players after a game awarding them for a great performance, viewable through their profile. Additionally, players can use in game currency to reward people outside of a match.
Match history
Inside of each player profile they will be able to view their match history, breaking down number games played and their results. 
Patch notes visible in game
At the bottom of the UI the version number will be visible with a button which will expand patch notes making it easier for players who skip the Steam update news to understand changes to the game.

High score system
We’re expanding our high score system to give players a variety of goals to aim for as they play Deceit.
Daily experience leader board
Resetting every day, players can compete to collect the most experience by winning games, completing objectives and helping their teammates. Each day, the players who collect the most will receive a reward.
Reputation leader board

notes.title: v2.8.0 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26303899/1116fcd93490c055e4f8806ce5d1a08d76428f91.jpg
Features 

 Arctic Map - Available from Wednesday 10th - due to issues found in beta testing
 Fuse System
[olist]
 Once a blackout has started the Game Master will activate a Fuse Box and deploy some Fuses around the map.
 If you fill the Fuse Box up with Fuses it will cause the blackout to end within 10s.
 You require 3/2/1 Fuses out of the 7/5/3 that spawn to complete the Fuse Box. This changes based on the zone you're in.
 Spawned Fuses will beep and be outlined when you're near them.
 The golden lever in the final zone has been replaced with this system.
 It is not required for the Fuse Box to be filled for the blackout to end but you do need to fill it to escape.
[/olist]
 Map Progression
[olist]
 Once a blackout has finished only one door will open to the next floor.
  The day periods are now 90/75/60s, scaling based on zone.
 Night periods last 90s.
[/olist]
 Terror Changes
[olist]
 Terrors now require 3 full slices of blood to be in Terror Form.
 You can only execute players when you have 3 full slices of blood.
 After executing your blood drains over 10 seconds and you will be put back into human form if you haven't already transformed back.
 Each blood bag now gives 1 full slice of blood.
 Health has been increased by 25%.
 Terrors now move 10% faster than humans, down from 20%.
 Fixed a bug where you could drink blood at full strength.
 The Camera flash no longer completely blinds you unless you're close.
 Terror Sense now scans the area every 5s instead of 10s but only detects running players.
[/olist]
 A tips system has  been added to the game to help new users, this gives instructions on how to play the game as they play for the the first five matches. For the experienced players they can be toggled  off from the  game settings.
 Three new sets of diary entries have been added and can be collected on the new arctic map.
 The loot booth cups game now allows you to choose the cup you want to pick.
 Players now can re queue to join a new game while in spectator mode.
 The CCTV cameras used in spectator mode have been replaced with a 3rd person follow camera.
 Replaced the blurry bleeding out camera with a third person camera.
 Added French, Polish, and Portuguese translations

Balancing

 You now have 40 seconds of Oxygen up from 30 seconds.
 The 'Vibrant' trait now blinds terrors when they are downed.
 Reworked the 'Vibrant' and 'Come prepared' traits to work more reliably.
 To take into account the changes to the loot booth there has been a reworked the rates of rare loot cups appearing in the loot booth cups game.
  Borrowed Time trait now reduces the time for the door to open by 1s per Fuse you put in the Fuse Box. You will have to complete the new challenge to use it again.
 Reserves trait  now has a chance to leave you with 1 slice instead of only using half the blood.
 Heightened Senses' trait challenge has doubled and makes Terror Sense update every 4s.

Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where the wrong map was displayed at the start of the loading screen
 Fixed a bug with the loot cups animations causing them to flicker.
 Removed rock that was covering some spawn points.

Miscellaneous

 Player nametags now fade out the further away you are.
 You can no longer walk through the target shoot objective.
 Easter has come to an end and the easter reward system has been removed.
 New Loot Cups animations

 Added French, Polish, and Portuguese translations

notes.notes:

Skill-based matchmaking: Matchmaking will now attempt to band players of a similar rank together

notes.notes:

Today we have reached a huge landmark! WE'RE OFFICIALLY OUT OF EARLY ACCESS \o/! Today's release marks our official transition to a fully fledged game, fancy that! We're not done though, we still plan to update weekly and provide you guys with more content to dig your terror mandibles into! Below is a list of the patch notes for this week's update, but if you've not played in a while be sure to check out our patch notes and YouTube tutorial series as a lot has changed.

Also, check out our fancy new trailer! (linked at the bottom)

Features

New Map! Today we release our second map 'The Forest' for you to deceive and trick your friends and enemies on!
Traits Leveling up your character now unlocks challenges that you can complete to unlock traits that give you a slight edge on others in the game! Level up all characters to 7 to unlock all of their traits and challenges.
ELO System! Reached rank 0? We have now implemented an ELO system which tracks how well you're playing relative to everyone else you're playing with.
GameMaster Notes! have been added to the game! Notes are outlined in purple and only 1 of each diary is spawned on each floor each game. Collect all the entries to answer questions about The Asylum, The GameMaster, and his secrets!
Terrors no longer have vision of innocents in the day period. During the night period a sonar effect happens every ten seconds to reveal player positions. Players who sprint will also be highlighted.
The concept of run energy has been removed.
Added a notification system to the main menu to inform you of level ups/game updates etc.
The character XP formula for the amount of XP required per level has been increased.
The in-game tutorial has been replaced by a link to our YouTube video series.
Players can now pickup armour when they already have (non-full) armour.
Winning a game now only awards 1 mark not 2. When de-ranking you are now given half the marks of the previous rank. (Higher number if odd number).
The start timer of a round has been increased to 20 seconds to account for trait selection
Added random map loading when a game is starting

Bug Fixes

Fixed not being able to un-crouch on top floor of the cell block.
Made blood bags on the middle and top floor of the asylum visible again.
Images on the UI are now preloaded correctly.
Infected players can now see the outlines of other infected players.
Fixed/improved a bunch of the steam achievements.
Fixed an issue where you could load 3 shots into the shotgun.
Fixed several optimization issues increasing FPS.
Fixed multiple crashes whilst closing the game.
Fixed a crash relating to the animation system.

Environment

Reduced shadow casting lights on low spec to increase performance
Fixed some level streaming issues
Fixed Collision at the bottom of the stairs on the second floor leading to the cell
Moved a number of blood bags and other consumables spawning in front of levers
Finalized the cell block room which is a large new room allowing for easier movement around the second floor, and adding 2 new ways up to the third floor.

Today we have reached a huge landmark! WE'RE OFFICIALLY OUT OF EARLY ACCESS \o/! Today's release marks our official transition to a fully fledged game, fancy that! We're not done though, we still plan to update weekly and provide you guys with more content to dig your terror mandibles into! Below is a list of the patch notes for this week's update, but if you've not played in a while be sure to check out our patch notes and YouTube tutorial series as a lot has changed.

Also, check out our fancy new trailer! (linked at the bottom)

Features

New Map! Today we release our second map 'The Forest' for you to deceive and trick your friends and enemies on!
Traits Leveling up your character now unlocks challenges that you can complete to unlock traits that give you a slight edge on others in the game! Level up all characters to 7 to unlock all of their traits and challenges.
ELO System! Reached rank 0? We have now implemented an ELO system which tracks how well you're playing relative to everyone else you're playing with.
GameMaster Notes! have been added to the game! Notes are outlined in purple and only 1 of each diary is spawned on each floor each game. Collect all the entries to answer questions about The Asylum, The GameMaster, and his secrets!
Terrors no longer have vision of innocents in the day period. During the night period a sonar effect happens every ten seconds to reveal player positions. Players who sprint will also be highlighted.
The concept of run energy has been removed.
Added a notification system to the main menu to inform you of level ups/game updates etc.
The character XP formula for the amount of XP required per level has been increased.
The in-game tutorial has been replaced by a link to our YouTube video series.
Players can now pickup armour when they already have (non-full) armour.
Winning a game now only awards 1 mark not 2. When de-ranking you are now given half the marks of the previous rank. (Higher number if odd number).
The start timer of a round has been increased to 20 seconds to account for trait selection
Added random map loading when a game is starting

Bug Fixes

Fixed not being able to un-crouch on top floor of the cell block.
Made blood bags on the middle and top floor of the asylum visible again.
Images on the UI are now preloaded correctly.
Infected players can now see the outlines of other infected players.
Fixed/improved a bunch of the steam achievements.
Fixed an issue where you could load 3 shots into the shotgun.
Fixed several optimization issues increasing FPS.
Fixed multiple crashes whilst closing the game.
Fixed a crash relating to the animation system.

Environment

Reduced shadow casting lights on low spec to increase performance
Fixed some level streaming issues
Fixed Collision at the bottom of the stairs on the second floor leading to the cell
Moved a number of blood bags and other consumables spawning in front of levers
Finalized the cell block room which is a large new room allowing for easier movement around the second floor, and adding 2 new ways up to the third floor.
Added more spectator points to the asylum
Fixed an issue where a large amount of decals weren't showing, including puddles
Enlarged the bathroom on the second floor, increasing the playable area for more fluid gameplay

Audio

Added character voices.
Fixed missing objective capture sound.
Fixed broken terror proximity ambiance.
Fixed end of round SFX.

Animation

Fixed 'into iron sights' transition for female characters
Tweaked inspection kit's animations
Fixed issue where downed people appear as t-posed

notes.title: 24th Feb – Game Update, Release Schedule & Play Sessions
notes.notes:
Hi all,

This week we've released a version of the new Deceit, which incorporates the core gameplay changes that we've developed through our early access testing (including a further update today with more areas of the Asylum now available!). We have been very happy with how the majority of the changes have turned out and now have the gameplay in a great spot for our full launch. However, we are aware that the metagame (character levelling and interfaces), general user interface, tutorial content, website and community involvement are not up-to-scratch for the switch to transition to a non-early-access launch on Steam. Naturally, there's also a load of polish we'd continue to like to work on (animations, graphics, interfaces) as we continue to update Deceit. We will now continue to push weekly or bi-weekly updates as we work on these.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26303899/d1e2d10368ed0af4375e2c8ed1c74a13ba2db204.png

It's most important to us that we take a few more days to polish each of these aspects so that we can grow the game most effectively when it is featured by Steam and other platforms on launch. We will be dramatically increasing our community management and marketing efforts over the coming days, so it can be clearer to you what to expect from our weekly updates from here on out, and it is clearer to new players how to get involved.

We're sorry for the delay pushing the button to bring in more users, but we have already begun scheduling in content creators for next week, and we are confident that we can build up the community with increasing effectiveness as the game progresses. We won't give an exact date for when the launch will be until we are 100% confident that we have everything in-place for launch, but we can say that we have done the vast majority of the work over the last month, and if you have any questions, please get in contact on Discord! We'll also be updating our website and Steam community with a lot more content over the next couple weeks as part of our investment community and marketing.

Thank you to everyone who's supported us and given us feedback during the early phases of Deceit, it's been a very ambitious project with a very unique idea and totally new engine platform, so we've come a long way in less than a year, and we intend to take the game much further over the next few weeks.

Finally, we will be announcing dev play sessions multiple times a week starting next week, at various times of day, so stay tuned for our Twitter or Discord announcements for more of these, and for upcoming streams & videos!

notes.title: V2.0a Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello! Have you missed us? Since our last patch 6 weeks ago we've been hard at work overhauling the entire game mode and re-working almost every core system in the game. We're releasing this preview of our major changes to Deceit in order to give our early access players a sneak peak of our full game release, and to gather any feedback for tweaks we can make.

Objectives

There are now levers scattered across each floor that are required to activate the objectives on that floor
Pulling a lever gives you a waypoint to the appropriate objective
Keep an eye out for the Infected as they can deactivate levers before the objective has been started
Objectives that require two people to complete do not have levers associated with them
Completing objectives now gives you the reward but also increases the length of the day period, and reduces the length of the dark period
A new objective type has been added which requires you to damage three targets (knifing works as well as shooting)


Consumables

You can find ammo scattered on the floor around the map
You can find armour on the floor around the map
Keep an eye out for Infected as they can now find blood bags on drip stands around the map to gain strength (no longer objective rewards)


Respawning

Whilst downed other players can deal damage to vote on your elimination
After being downed you will now respawn somewhere else on your current floor after an amount of time
Your down time will increase for 5 seconds per vote cast on you so other players have time to vote on you
The votes cast on you reset when you get back up
The amount of votes required to eliminate someone becomes less per floor
Players other than the person that downed you can interact you to revive you on the spot


Escaping

At the end of each blackout there will be routes waypointed to get to the next floor that will open automatically, you no longer need to get a key
If you don't progress through the map fast enough after the lights come back on a toxic gas will start to kill you (which also affects the Infected now)
On the top floor there will be an escape lever (gold outline) that when pulled causes the lights to go out indefinitely and giving the Infected full strength
The escape lever can only be pulled when the other objective levers are activate, the Infected cannot deactive this lever
Once the escape lever is active you should head towards the waypointed escape door and interact with it which after a few seconds will open so you can escape


Win Condition

Players no longer win as a team, scoring is based on individual play:
An Innocent can win by escaping
An Infected can win if nobody escapes


Ranking System

From completing games you will now gain marks towards ranks:
If you win you will gain 2 marks
Innocent get an additional 1 bonus mark if someone escapes with them
Infected get an additional 1 bonus mark if the other Infected survives with them
If you lose you will lose 1 mark
There are different bands of ranks:
Bronze (ranks 20-16) requires 2 marks to rank up
Silver (ranks 15-11 requires 3 marks to rank up
Gold (ranks 10-6) requires 4 marks to rank up
Platinum (ranks 5-1) requires 5 marks to rank up
Diamond (rank 0) we will be adding an ELO system for players at this rank to compete on the highscores
If you lose a mark at zero marks within a rank you will derank with 1 mark at that rank, though you cannot derank out of a band
At the end of each month your rank will reset and you will be given a head-start towards the next months ranking


Character Leveling

You will gain XP from doing various things during a game
XP is character specific and allows you to level characters up to level 7, unlocking rewards at each
You can continue to gain XP when you're at level 7 and work towards further crates being given
The main benefit from leveling characters is that each level gives access to new trait slots, though it is worth mentioning that traits are currently disabled


Environment

Lots of general polish to the asylum (graffiti, debris, general cleanup etc)
Added an elevator shaft to one of the staircases
Added new route up to the top floor through one of the staircases
Added new 'Lift Lobby' room that connects the new route up from the middle floor to the canteen
New lighting pass that drastically improves general FPS in the asylum


Animation

Fixed issue where items weren't showing in characters hands on the main menu
Fixed animation ragdoll issue when downed in third person
Fixed skinning issues to Change, Rachel, Lisa, and their clothing
Added 'into' and 'out of' transition blends to iron sights
Fixes to third person pistol, camera and shotgun locomotion blending
Fixes to the first person shotgun animations, keeping hands attached to the weapon


Miscellaneous

Upgraded to the newest version of CryEngine (version 5.3.2)
Added 22 new victory/defeat poses to the loot crates
Reworked almost every UI element (both in game and on menu)
Removed the concept of "crippling" after being downed
Players names and ranks now display on the loading screen
Moved a lot of player spawns
Moved and added new CCTV cameras
Players now spawn with just 6 bullets
Added a grain effect to the CCTV cameras
Added voice and length of down periods to name tags-
Added indication for how long you're tracked for
If you reach 0 run energy whilst holding shift it will no longer stutter
You can no longer see your own name tag
Fixed a bug where stamina wouldn't regenerate at the same rate after reviving
Name tags are now hidden when you're downed

notes.title: Full Game Launch and Planned Changes
notes.notes:
Hello!

Now 2017 is in full swing, we're excited to announce our full launch on 24th February. We have big plans for Deceit between now and then as we are planning to do our last big early access changes before our release. To wet your appetite, here are some of the things we have planned (subject to change):

Gameplay Changes

To keep the gameplay fresh and replayable we're giving you more things to do in the day time, more reasons to doubt each other, and more ways to get around the map. Here are a few of the changes we're planning:

Completing objectives now increases the length of the day period and reduces the length of the night period.
Each objective is activated by pulling a lever somewhere on the map. If an objective is active and not started yet, the lever can be pulled to make it inactive.
Doors now automatically open to the next floor after a blackout, and there is no longer a key.
Ammo points are being removed, and instead there will be consumables placed around the map that are 'used' as soon as you pick them up (blood bags, ammo, armour, energy etc).
Terrors will now be able to utilise the vents on the map to teleport around the map, in order to keep up their sneakiness.
Players are now eliminated through the game by voting. Downing a player triggers a vote, and then other players can shoot their downed body to also vote for that player. Once enough votes have been cast, the player is then eliminated from the game.
Once downed, players can now be revived by other players. If they aren't, they will re-spawn in a location on that floor. (Terror executions still eliminate)


Seasonal Ranking System

Players will now rank up and compete on a monthly seasonal basis to determine who is the best Deceit player in the world! The ladder will reset each month and you will start at the beginning of the ladder at rank 20. Each game you play you will gain 2 marks for a win, and lose one mark if you lose. Each rank will require a certain number of marks to rank up, and once you hit a certain rank you can not drop below that rank band until the ladder resets. Once a player reaches the top of the ranking system, they are then added to our leaderboard which will determine who the best deceivers are based on an ELO system, similar to how chess works. The top deceivers each month will then win prizes based on how well they have performed that month! (Note: winning will now be on an individual basis, so those clutch 1 man innocent escapes will still rank you up!)

Character Leveling

We are replacing the current leveling and prestiging systems with a system that allows you to level on a per-character basis, and your trait slots will be tied to the level of your character. Don't worry! All progress currently made in the game will be transferable to the characters, so none of your time you've spent in the asylum will have been wasted.

Forest Map (Name TBD)

Our second outdoor map is being released alongside our full launch. It is a night time outdoor map, which really lets the terrors run havoc: jumping over rocks, hiding behind trees, and sneaking up on people from any direction. Below is a sneak preview of what to expect:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26303899/281a8e1eb67f324cb1027d2820b80466ae2fecbe.png

These are a few of the core changes that we're making between now and the full release, alongside other useful technical tasks such as upgrading to the newest version of CryEngine 5, generally polishing the game, and adding new ways to find out answers to all of your burning questions about the game's lore. Thank you to everyone who has been playing Deceit since we launched in EA and have seen how far it has come in such a short period. We're really interested to hear your feedback on these changes, so please leave a comment or come and chat in our Discord to let us know what you think.

The Automaton Team

notes.title: v1.8 Patch Notes - Merry Christmas!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26303899/64b7a1247144954c622ec2cd64f1eea3fc870381.jpg

This Deceit patch is packed full of new game play mechanics, game features, a new character, a new weapon, terror unlocks, Christmas decorations all around the asylum, and a whole bunch of fixes! Check below for the patch notes, and jump into game and get your Christmas Spook on!

Patch Notes

Gameplay

Only a fixed number of objectives are now required to activate the key
Terrors can now be downed when shot and flashed at
The shotgun - a new objective reward - has been added into the game. This replaces your pistol for a limited time and packs one hell of a punch to both humans and terrors
Another objective point has been added to the middle floor (can spawn as both the 2 person key objective as well as a regular objective)
Strength is no longer used up over time. Simply one third (a slice) of the bar is required per execution
The infected lose a slice of their bar when downed in terror form, or two slices when downed in human form
The terror bar is now filled based on innocents getting downed (half a slice no matter who downed the innocent, or a whole slice if you downed them personally)


Features

Rachel has been added to the game
Support for terror unlocks has been added.
Users who have hit level 30 now have the clown terror unlock. This unlock will now be a rare unlock available from crates
Integrated steam achievements
Added character specific challenges to the game which are rewarded with character traits on completion
Added 3 traits per character which slightly boost different aspects of the characters whilst playing them
Lots of Christmas rewards have been added to the crates that are available for a limited time only
You now only select the character you play at the beginning of a round
Partial support has been added for prestiging when a user hits level 99


Main Menu

Lots of UI elements as well as the general look and feel has been re-worked
Character loadouts have been added to the menu, including new options for terror loadouts
Tutorial slides have been added to the menu
The trait configuration and challenge systems have been added to the menu


Environment

Additional lighting tweaks through the map
Added flickering TVs and TV effects
Added Christmas decorations
Added snow to the Atrium
Fixed some issues with disappearing objects


Animation

Added animations for Rachel
Added animations for the shotgun
'Into smoothing' animations have been added to movement and sprinting with the pistol
The inspection kit has now been given a model and animations when used
Fixed issues with knifing
Fixed issues with aim poses


Audio

Added sound to indicate the proximity of the closest terror
Added more environmental sounds
Added shotgun sound effects


Bug Fixes

notes.title: Public Release 7th October & Further Testing Today
notes.notes:
Hi all,

We're really excited for our public launch into early-access. However, it's extremely important to us that the game is stable, and all of its core components are working before we allow anyone to buy it. Due to a few issues we've found during compatibility testing, we've unfortunately had to make the decision restrict our launch to a larger number of testers today, rather than the whole of Steam.

This will also allow us to begin the localization of the game into other languages, and work with international streamers on launch to promote the game.

On the up-side, we're happy that the game is performing well overall, being the first game to be built for release on the new CryEngine V platform, and operating on our new matchmaking network. We're confident Friday at 3PM GMT is a strong time to launch. We'll also be beginning our marketing campaign for the game tomorrow, allowing us to reach a larger community for launch.

Thanks very much for your understanding, and we really look forward to working with the early access community as soon as we can!

Regards,
The Automaton Team
